summary: Connect project appraisal, fiscal affordability, procurement, and evaluation. Explore practical public investment management training with TrainingCred.
lede: Public investment management training helps finance and planning professionals assess proposals and connect project selection with budget and delivery decisions. Participants practise building project pipelines, applying cost-benefit analysis, screening climate risks, and comparing projects for affordability and priority. They also work on procurement-readiness checks and reporting delivery and evaluation evidence to support decisions across the project cycle.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for moving public capital proposals through appraisal, budget decisions, procurement, delivery, and evaluation. It is designed for roles that coordinate investment decisions across planning, finance, and implementing bodies.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public budgeting, project preparation, or public-sector infrastructure decisions is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use project information and Excel-style pipeline records.
